experimental_brief_candidate.bounded_headline: Seven selected WDI relationships show one recurring warning: level correlations weaken materially in same-year annual changes.
experimental_brief_candidate.evidence_frontier_limitation: The admitted frontier has raw and first-difference Pearson evidence only; no significance, stationarity, rolling, lagged, rank, regression, partial-correlation, subperiod, break, regime, or robustness family is admitted.
experimental_brief_candidate.exact_case_scope: Three core governed Production Inquiry cases, one qualified checkpoint-nonconforming analytical byproduct, and three context-only result-informed T-035 comparisons.
experimental_brief_candidate.governance_and_selection_qualifications: The rows are small, selected, nonrandom, and dependent. T-035 does not enlarge the core governed sample; T-036 remains qualified; T-038 uses inherited selection.
experimental_brief_candidate.most_important_counterinterpretation: Attenuation may coexist with meaningful long-run level relationships and does not identify trend, spuriousness, reversal, absence, or any predominant cause.
experimental_brief_candidate.reader_interpretation_change: Read a strong raw correlation as a prompt for transformation-aware challenge, not as self-sufficient evidence of stable contemporaneous co-movement or mechanism.
experimental_brief_candidate.repeated_pattern: All seven rows have smaller absolute first-difference Pearson coefficients; four change sign; all are classified weakens materially.
unresolved_questions: Which explanation dominates in each case?
Do lagged, nonlinear, subperiod, break, regime, or revision-aware analyses alter interpretation?
How sensitive are results to windows, missing years, and outliers?

inclusion_rule: Include all seven explicit T-039 relationship cases, both coefficients and states for every case, all accepted classifications, the exact 3/1/3 evidence hierarchy, all governing qualifications, dependence, selection, provenance, and obligations.
mandatory_intro: This BriefForge presentation organizes accepted InsightForge T-039 findings without recomputing, reassessing, or changing their analytical authority.

analytical_practice_guidance: Treat a strong raw correlation as a question generator, not as evidence of a stable short-run relationship.
Verify source ownership, package identity, method, transformation, aligned periods, counts, and missingness before interpretation.
Compare raw and transformation-aware evidence before writing a mechanism or decision narrative.
Describe attenuation as weakening of the raw interpretation, not as proof of spuriousness, reversal, absence, or a predominant trend cause.
Inspect time-index diagnostics, denominator and composition risks, measurement construction, and coverage when they are admitted, while preserving their diagnostic limits.
Preserve case-specific alternatives and cross-case dependence instead of counting relationship rows as independent replications.
Escalate only to admitted evidence capable of discriminating lag, nonlinearity, subperiod, break, regime, outlier, significance, revision, or mechanism alternatives.
Stop when the available evidence only repeats the same raw-versus-first-difference contrast without adding discrimination.

mandatory_synthesis.estimand_boundary: Raw and first-difference coefficients answer different estimands: same-period co-movement in levels versus same-period co-movement in annual changes. Attenuation is a transformation-aware reassessment, not a corrected estimate of the same quantity.
mandatory_synthesis.observed_pattern: Every explicitly included relationship has a smaller absolute first-difference coefficient than raw coefficient and was published with the qualitative classification weakens materially.
mandatory_synthesis.replication_interpretation: The repeated observation is credible as a workflow-level warning across heterogeneous relationships, but not as seven independent replications of one economic law or one causal explanation.
